trainable: only newly added E,Q,K,V,gate,P_h,fusion,output; all original/B300/Bridge/codec frozen
bias: all new conv bias=False except gate final bias=True (default uniform)
initialization: full audited B300 overlay hash; fresh matched branch by seed, never load prior S/T step300
normalization: none; no train/dev input scale fitting
precision: FP32 branch, complete decoder prefix/suffix and losses; inherited independent codec FP16; TF32 off

flow.source: independent Original decoded current/past RGB, frozen torchvision RAFT large C_T_SKHT_V2
flow.grid: RGB (8x+3.5,8y+3.5), align_corners=False, sample original projected K/V once
flow.validity: intersection of S and T per-candidate bounds, shared causal FB validity and native RGB center bounds
flow.S: current content on unshifted grid; shares past availability, decoded scene-cut, FB error and intersection mask with T
flow.gate: 388->64 k3 SiLU ->1 k1 sigmoid times valid
flow.scene_cut: decoded RGB mean absolute difference>0.35 closes added history and resets TCG states at that frame when metadata is available

sequence.prefix: frozen causal tcg_low/mid through all P1..63, RAM-only prefix; never use old terminal h
sequence.warmup: two candidate suffix frames start-2,start-1 under no_grad; independent tcg_out state, detach boundary
sequence.temporal_gradient: within each supervised 2/4-frame clip, both history E and candidate tcg_out input state retain graph; detach between clips
sequence.TCG_out: functional exact frozen module with explicit current-input state; never replay B300 state

training_spatial_scope: entire padded feature grid through differentiable decoder suffix including GN; loss on fixed pre-scheduled 256x256 ROI, separately full-frame metrics

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.microbatch: one continuous clip; loss summed by frame/4

selection: no checkpoint-based stopping or model promotion; fixed 0/300/600/900 comparisons, final-test only900 after every group finishes
evaluation: all own-training sources and identical new-to-ST validation6 at all4 checkpoints; final-test6 at900 only after all8 groups; video-equal means, source bootstrap CI; temporal observation only
interventions: T source replaced by current at same true coordinates (distribution shift)
T added history gate off (distribution shift)

devices.mapping: one own worker per GPU, dynamically queued after free-memory check; existing jobs allowed by explicit authorization

storage.original_RGB_storage: lossless half m1p1 with exact unit roundtrip assertion

determinism: fixed seeds/schedule, TF32 off, cudnn deterministic; deterministic_algorithms(True,warn_only=True) after audited restore because CUDA grid_sample backward is nondeterministic; exact bitwise training reproducibility not claimed
hardware: GPU0-3 shared occupancy explicitly authorized if memory sufficient;1own worker/card, free-memory guard28000MiB; no unrelated termination
decision_rules: train improves while new validation stagnates/worsens: overfitting risk under recorded900-step schedule
D12 validation better than D4 at same step across sources/seeds: evidence for source diversity effect
S and T both improve over B300 but T-S close: shared new branch effect, not history increment
only repeatable T superiority on multiple validation sources and both seeds supports added history
uncertainty: bootstrap source units, seeds averaged inside each source; separate seeds and per-source deltas; adjacent frames/pixels/crops not independent videos
test_exposure: historically evaluated source-isolated holdout; not blind; no reuse of previous dev/confirm as fresh test

decision_thresholds.history_repeatability: at900, LPIPS and DISTS mean improve in both seeds and joint improvement on>=4/6validation sources in each seed; report source bootstrap95% CI descriptively
decision_thresholds.no_claim: engineering interpretation thresholds, not universal significance margins
